title: Persevering Grace
definition: Persevering Grace is God's keeping work by which true believers continue in faith until the end.
summary: Persevering Grace is God's ongoing work that keeps believers trusting, repenting, and enduring to the end.
christFocus: Jesus Christ keeps His sheep, intercedes for them, and brings them safely into glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Persevering grace is God's faithful work of keeping His people in faith until the end. Scripture calls believers to endure, but it also teaches that God preserves those who belong to Christ.

This doctrine does not make perseverance automatic in a careless way. God keeps His people through warnings, promises, discipline, fellowship, prayer, and the ongoing work of the Spirit.

Jesus is the Shepherd who loses none of His own. The believer continues because Christ intercedes, guards, and finishes what He began.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Suffering, temptation, and failure can make believers fear they will never endure. Persevering grace gives confidence without removing the call to watchfulness and faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Keep going by using the means God gives: Scripture, prayer, confession, fellowship, worship, and repentance. Encourage weary believers that endurance is not self-salvation; it is grace carrying them home.
